rationale: The agent verified the user via full name and zip, matched to a single account, and reviewed all orders using read-only tools. They correctly identified two pending orders eligible for cancellation, requested the user’s reason, and explicitly sought confirmation before performing any cancellations. After receiving confirmation, they executed cancellations via the appropriate tool calls, and the tool outputs confirm both orders were cancelled with refunds issued to the correct credit card. Final communication accurately reflected the outcomes and refund amounts/timeline. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed.
